at: Pumsuk looks at him the way he used to look at his tutors
alt: On the gatehouse, Pumsuk turns to Jukjuk for the answer; Jukjuk stands silent and does not give it.
scene: Two-shot on the gatehouse at night. Pumsuk in new Silla armour turns to the older officer beside him, eyes pleading for the answer. Jukjuk, weathered, steady, plain yellow-sleeved officer under lamellar, looks back and says nothing. Torchlight between them.

at: Mochuk is at the river postern with the bar already lifted.
alt: Mochuk holds the river postern open as Gumil comes toward him out of the burning granary.
scene: Low shot at the river postern at night. Mochuk holds the lifted bar, face turned to Gumil, who walks toward him out of the orange glow of the burning granary.

at: My father named me for the bamboo.
alt: Jukjuk holds the inner gate at sunrise with the last of the garrison.
scene: Worm's-eye at the inner gate as the sun comes up through smoke. Jukjuk stands in the gate with the last men, sword up, unbent.
